modules.title: Mathematical reasoning + proof
core_concepts: Translate English claims into quantified statements; negate precisely; identify hidden assumptions and counterexamples.
Choose proof strategy from logical form; distinguish definition expansion from theorem invocation; write readable proofs.
Use counterexamples, induction, functions/inverses, and invariant-style reasoning.
modules.exit_capability: Own definitions, quantifiers, implication, counterexample, induction and proof structure.
modules.deletion_reason: Without quantifiers, counterexamples and proof, specifications cannot distinguish testing from necessity.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Calculus + vector calculus
core_concepts: Interpret limits as local behavior; reason about continuity and approximation rather than symbolic manipulation only.
Treat derivatives as local linear maps/rates; connect geometry, units, sensitivity and dynamics.
Linearize nonlinear systems, formulate local sensitivity, and use derivatives for optimization/root finding.
Treat integration as accumulation/conservation; connect rates to stocks and local to global quantities.
Represent geometry, motion, forces and trajectories in 3D; manipulate dot/cross products and vector kinematics.
Own gradient, directional derivative, Jacobian, multiple integrals, flux/circulation and divergence/curl intuition.
modules.exit_capability: Own limits, derivatives as local linearization, integrals as accumulation, gradients/Jacobians, line/surface integrals and field theorems.
modules.deletion_reason: Without local linearization and accumulation, continuous physical models and their approximations cannot be reconstructed.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Linear algebra
core_concepts: Represent state/data as vectors; use norms, inner products, angles and linear maps.
Diagnose redundancy, basis choice, rank and matrix-as-map thinking.
Solve linear systems; reason about reachability over repeated matrix dynamics; interpret inverses and condition.
Derive least squares as projection; understand residual orthogonality and regression geometry.
Handle constraints, nonlinear fitting, SVD/eigenstructure, low-rank approximation and ill-conditioning.
modules.exit_capability: Own vector spaces, projections, least squares, matrix maps, rank/nullspace, conditioning, SVD and eigenstructure.
modules.deletion_reason: Without rank, projection and conditioning, inverse problems and multivariate models hide non-identifiability.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: ODEs + dynamical systems
core_concepts: Translate verbal rate laws into ODEs; solve and interpret first-order models and equilibrium behavior.
Analyze oscillators, characteristic roots, transient/steady response and resonance.
Represent coupled state dynamics; connect eigenstructure to modes and stability.
Analyze nonlinear equilibria, local stability, phase portraits and bifurcation-style qualitative changes.
Recognize timescale separation, nonlinear feedback, bifurcation and chaotic sensitivity.
modules.exit_capability: Translate changing systems into state equations; solve and analyze equilibria, stability, oscillation, nonlinear behavior and feedback.
modules.deletion_reason: Without state evolution, equilibria and stability, feedback and time-dependent physical systems become opaque.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Probability
core_concepts: Define sample spaces/events; count without over/undercounting; move between symmetry stories and formal probability.
Update beliefs with evidence; use total probability/Bayes; distinguish independence from mutual exclusivity.
Model uncertainty with random variables; exploit linearity of expectation; reason with variance and indicators.
Work with densities, Normal/Exponential models, covariance/correlation, joint/marginal/conditional distributions.
Transform variables, condition on information, use bounds/LLN/CLT and know approximation regimes.
modules.exit_capability: Quantify uncertainty, conditioning, expectation, dependence, transformations, concentration and asymptotics.
modules.deletion_reason: Without conditional probability and distributions, uncertain evidence cannot support calibrated decisions.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Statistics + causal inference
core_concepts: Define counterfactual causal effects and target trials; separate identification from association.
Build DAGs; identify backdoor paths, colliders, selection and measurement structures.
Connect estimands to model-based estimators; understand IPW, standardization, outcome models, propensity and IV assumptions.
Design observational analyses as explicit trial emulations; align eligibility, treatment, time zero and follow-up.
modules.exit_capability: Define estimands; separate prediction from intervention; identify confounding, selection and measurement bias; estimate and stress-test effects.
modules.deletion_reason: Without estimands, confounding and uncertainty, observational association is mistaken for intervention effects.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Scientific computing
core_concepts: Distinguish model error, conditioning and algorithmic error; solve linear/least-squares problems stably.
Implement Newton/secant, interpolation, finite differences and quadrature with convergence/error checks.
Integrate ODEs adaptively; connect eigen/SVD analysis to computational behavior and large systems.
Discretize continuum models and reason about stability, stiffness, convergence and boundary conditions.
modules.exit_capability: Know conditioning, numerical stability, approximation, iterative solution, ODE/PDE discretization and computational verification.
modules.deletion_reason: Without numerical error and reproducible computation, a plausible simulation cannot be independently checked.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Optimization
core_concepts: Recognize convex structure; prove sets/functions convex; use epigraph and composition rules.
Formulate standard convex problems; understand Lagrangian, dual function, KKT and sensitivity.
Connect optimization to fitting, regularization, estimation and design tradeoffs.
Understand descent/Newton methods, line search, equality constraints and barrier/interior-point ideas.
modules.exit_capability: Formulate objectives and constraints; understand convexity, duality, KKT conditions and numerical optimization; audit objectives.
modules.deletion_reason: Without constraints, duality and optimality conditions, designs confuse feasible improvement with a defensible optimum.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Information + signals
core_concepts: Quantify information and uncertainty; connect Bayesian inference to coding/statistical viewpoints.
Understand compression limits, mutual information, channel capacity and coding as reliability engineering.
Move fluently between time and frequency representations; understand convolution, sampling, aliasing and filters.
Design filters under noise/bandwidth constraints; relate observability/information to sensor design.
modules.exit_capability: Own entropy, mutual information, channel capacity, transforms, sampling, filtering, spectral reasoning and estimation limits.
modules.deletion_reason: Without sampling, spectra and information limits, measurements and communication hide irreversible information loss.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Control + estimation
core_concepts: Understand feedback/feedforward architectures, disturbance rejection, tracking and fundamental tradeoffs.
Build state-space models; analyze equilibria, linearization, modes and response.
Reason about controllability, observability and state feedback; understand unreachable/unseen modes.
Use frequency-domain reasoning for bandwidth, margins, disturbance/noise rejection and robustness.
Estimate hidden state from noisy measurements; integrate model, sensor and controller into an end-to-end loop.
modules.exit_capability: Design closed loops; analyze stability and robustness; infer hidden state; reason about controllability, observability and tradeoffs.
modules.deletion_reason: Without observability, estimation and stability, closed-loop systems can fail despite individually accurate components.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Metrology + experiments
modules.prerequisite_text: TS-F05; runs in parallel from the start
core_concepts: Separate measurand, instrument, calibration, bias, repeatability, reproducibility and uncertainty budget.
Design experiments that identify causal factors efficiently; use blocking, randomization, factorial thinking and response surfaces.
Distinguish common/special causes, process capability, drift, reliability and validation from a one-off demo.
modules.exit_capability: Calibrate, quantify uncertainty, design informative experiments, distinguish process variation from measurement variation and reproduce results.
modules.deletion_reason: Without calibration, error budgets and experimental design, model agreement can be an instrument artifact.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Mechanics + electromagnetism
core_concepts: Build free-body models; choose inertial frames; connect constraints/friction/drag to acceleration.
Switch between force-time and energy/momentum descriptions; identify conserved quantities and dissipation.
Model rigid-body rotation, torque, inertia, angular momentum and basic orbital/gravitational motion.
Move between charge, field, potential and stored electric energy; exploit symmetry with Gauss's law.
Model current networks and magnetic forces/fields; understand induction and inductive energy storage.
Reason about impedance, resonance, power and field propagation; connect circuits to waves.
modules.exit_capability: Convert forces, fields and conservation laws into predictive models; move between particle, rigid-body, orbital and field descriptions.
modules.deletion_reason: Without conservation and electromagnetic fields, machines and circuits lose their physical constraint model.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Thermodynamics + statistical mechanics
core_concepts: Distinguish temperature, internal energy and heat; connect microscopic motion to pressure and transport scales.
Write control-volume energy balances; distinguish work modes and state vs path variables.
Understand entropy as state-count/information-compatible quantity and second-law constraint.
Use partition functions to obtain equilibrium averages and connect micro/macro descriptions.
Reason about free energies, phase stability, diffusion/viscosity/thermal conduction and heat rejection.
modules.exit_capability: Track energy, entropy and free energy; derive equilibrium tendencies; connect microscopic states to macroscopic limits and transport.
modules.deletion_reason: Without entropy, free energy and statistical ensembles, energy conversion and material behavior are misbounded.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Quantum + condensed matter
core_concepts: Use wavefunction/amplitude/probability ideas and understand why classical trajectories fail microscopically.
Solve simple bound/tunneling systems; use operators/eigenstates/uncertainty and superposition.
Connect quantized structure to atomic spectra, orbitals and selection-rule intuition.
Understand crystal lattices, free electrons, bands, Fermi surfaces, semiconductors and phonons.
Connect collective excitations and order to thermal/electronic/magnetic properties; identify what remains unexplained for frontier materials.
modules.exit_capability: Reason with wavefunctions/operators and connect quantum states to bands, semiconductors, phonons, magnetism and superconductivity.
modules.deletion_reason: Without quantum states and material electronic structure, device-scale explanations become unsupported analogies.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Chemistry + materials
core_concepts: Predict bonding and molecular/solid structure from electronic structure and intermolecular forces.
Use crystal systems, Miller indices, XRD intuition, defects and band concepts to connect structure to properties.
Connect rate laws, activation barriers, equilibrium constants and free energy.
Model redox potentials, cells, transport and degradation; understand electrochemical energy storage.
Use phase diagrams and material indices; connect processing/defects/microstructure to performance and manufacturability.
modules.exit_capability: Predict bonding, reaction direction/rate, electrochemistry, diffusion, phase behavior and processing-structure-property links.
modules.deletion_reason: Without bonding, kinetics and processing-structure-property relations, materials choices cannot be defended.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Electronics + embedded systems
core_concepts: Analyze passive networks and interfaces; reason about loading, time constants, energy and measurement.
Use semiconductor devices as switches/amplifiers and design basic analog signal conditioning.
Design frequency-selective networks and basic power conversion while accounting for losses and switching.
Bridge physical signals to deterministic computation and back; understand timing and concurrency at device scale.
Integrate sensing, analog front-end, computation, communications, actuation and power into one architecture.
modules.exit_capability: Design and instrument circuits from passive networks through semiconductor interfaces, sensing, power conversion and real-time embedded control.
modules.deletion_reason: Without circuits, timing and embedded constraints, sensing and actuation cannot be made reliable in hardware.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Mechanical design + fluids + structures
core_concepts: Translate loads into stress/strain/deflection; distinguish material stiffness, geometry and safety factor.
Understand thin-walled structures, buckling intuition, load paths and mass-efficient shell/stiffener concepts.
Build control-volume fluid models; relate pressure, velocity, elevation, losses and regime.
Reason about cyclic loads, damage accumulation, joints, composites and inspectability/repair.
Integrate structures, fluids, thermal loads, mechanisms, tolerances and controls into a real assembly.
modules.exit_capability: Turn loads and flows into safe geometry; reason about stress, fatigue, shells, fluids, pumps, pressure systems and mass-efficient structures.
modules.deletion_reason: Without stress, flow, geometry and stability, mechanical designs conceal failure under real loads.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Molecular + cell biology
core_concepts: Understand compartments, membranes, transport, electrochemical gradients and organelle functions.
Track biological energy, redox carriers, ATP and metabolic pathways as controlled reaction networks.
Understand receptors, signaling cascades, feedback, proliferation checkpoints and cell-state transitions.
Understand information storage, replication fidelity, transcription, translation and mutation sources.
Understand gene regulation, PCR/sequencing/editing concepts, biotechnology workflows and measurement limitations.
modules.exit_capability: Model cells as chemical, energetic, informational and mechanical systems; understand membranes, metabolism, signaling, division and gene expression.
modules.deletion_reason: Without cellular mechanisms and regulation, biological interventions lack a causal substrate.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Genetics + evolution + systems biology
modules.prerequisite_text: TS-F07; dynamics, probability and causal inference
core_concepts: Reason about segregation, recombination, linkage, genotype-phenotype uncertainty and allele-frequency dynamics.
Model gene circuits with Hill/Michaelis-like functions, feedback and network motifs.
Model stochastic gene expression and evolutionary adaptation under finite populations.
Analyze eco-evolutionary feedback, games, predator-prey/interactions, resilience and critical transitions.
modules.exit_capability: Reason about inheritance, variation, population change, gene circuits, network motifs, stochastic expression and evolutionary robustness.
modules.deletion_reason: Without inheritance, selection and system interaction, biological predictions ignore adaptation and population variation.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Neuroscience + physiology
modules.prerequisite_text: TS-F05, TS-F07; signals, control and probability
core_concepts: Model membrane potentials, spikes, integrate-and-fire behavior and neural coding fundamentals.
Decode hidden variables from neural activity and understand population representations/adaptation.
Understand multi-loop physiological homeostasis: endocrine signaling, circulation, gas exchange and autonomic regulation.
Understand filtration, osmoregulation, electrolyte and acid-base homeostasis as controlled transport systems.
modules.exit_capability: Connect electrophysiology and neural coding to whole-body homeostasis and cardiovascular, respiratory, endocrine and renal control.
modules.deletion_reason: Without neural and physiological mechanisms, human-interface and health claims lose their biological bounds.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Manufacturing + operations
core_concepts: Choose manufacturing processes from geometry/material/rate/quality/cost constraints.
Translate metrology into yield/capability/process control and diagnose variation sources.
Reason about capacity, bottlenecks, WIP, cycle time, utilization, flow and production economics.
Integrate process physics, quality, maintenance, supply chain, learning curve and capital deployment.
modules.exit_capability: Translate prototypes into processes with rate, yield, variation, quality, cost, maintenance, supply chain and learning curves.
modules.deletion_reason: Without yield, variation, throughput and quality control, a laboratory success is mistaken for scalable production.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Safety + reliability + security
core_concepts: Model accidents as unsafe control and interaction failures, not only broken components.
Quantify reliability while knowing when independence/component models are inadequate.
Threat-model systems across technical, physical, human and economic attack surfaces.
Build an evidence-backed safety/reliability/security case with requirements, hazards, threats, tests and operational monitoring.
modules.exit_capability: Design systems that remain safe and dependable under component failure, software defects, organizational drift, misuse and adversaries.
modules.deletion_reason: Without hazard analysis, reliability and security, component performance can conceal unacceptable system risk.
modules.gate: Reconstruct -> transfer -> break -> bound -> check -> defend

modules.title: Grammar & Sentence Architecture
modules.exit_capability: Build, parse, combine, split, and deliberately vary English sentences while preserving exact logical relations.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, every higher expressive task becomes unreliable: ambiguity, rhythm, emphasis, and argument can fail at sentence level.
modules.gate: Parse + reconstruct + sentence transformation + defense

modules.title: Diction, Semantics, Idiom & Lexical Precision
modules.exit_capability: Choose words for exact meaning, implication, register, rhythm, and social effect; diagnose near-synonym differences.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, the writer can form grammatical sentences but cannot reliably say exactly the thing intended.
modules.gate: Definition contrasts + lexical substitution + boundary cases

modules.title: Cohesion, Paragraphs & Information Flow
modules.exit_capability: Control what the reader knows, expects, and notices from sentence to sentence and paragraph to paragraph.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, locally good sentences fail to become intelligible sustained thought.
modules.gate: Reorder/revise passage + unseen exposition problem

modules.title: Rhetoric, Argument, Audience & Occasion
modules.exit_capability: Make a precise case for a skeptical audience, adapt it to occasion, and distinguish persuasion from proof.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, expression cannot reliably change minds, defend propositions, or survive disagreement.
modules.gate: Argument map + counterargument + audience transformation + oral defense

modules.title: Image, Figurative Language & Analogy
modules.exit_capability: Render perception, emotion, abstraction, and relation through concrete language and controlled figurative structures.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, English remains propositionally usable but loses compression, vividness, discovery, and many forms of emotional precision.
modules.gate: Concrete rendering + figure generation + failed-analogy diagnosis

modules.title: Voice, Tone, Register & Persona
modules.exit_capability: Produce recognizably different voices and registers without changing underlying facts; infer stance from linguistic evidence.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, the writer cannot control social meaning, attitude, intimacy, authority, irony, or identity through language.
modules.gate: Same-content multi-register composition + tone defense

modules.title: Narrative: Point of View, Time, Scene & Summary
modules.exit_capability: Narrate the same events under different viewpoints, time structures, and information constraints while controlling reader inference.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, experience cannot be shaped into intelligible stories or causal sequences.
modules.gate: Retell event under changed POV/time + narrative diagnosis

modules.title: Dialogue, Drama & Subtext
modules.exit_capability: Write speech that simultaneously performs action, reveals character, withholds information, and advances conflict.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, represented conversation becomes exposition with quotation marks rather than social action.
modules.gate: Subtext scene + speech-act analysis + performance defense

modules.title: Poetry: Rhythm, Meter, Line & Sound
modules.exit_capability: Hear, scan, and deliberately organize sound and line so form contributes to meaning rather than decorating it.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, a major expressive dimension of English—timing, recurrence, sonic expectation, and lineation—remains uncontrolled.
modules.gate: Scansion + line-break transformation + compose under form constraint

modules.title: Essay, Exposition, Definition & Criticism
modules.exit_capability: Explain difficult ideas clearly, define contested terms, compare models, and write interpretive criticism supported by textual evidence.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, the learner can create effects but cannot reliably expose reasoning and interpretation to inspection.
modules.gate: Analytical essay + definition test + evidence defense

modules.title: Close Reading, Form, Genre & Literary Tradition
modules.exit_capability: Read unfamiliar literary language closely, identify formal choices, situate them historically, and defend interpretations without pretending ambiguity is arbitrary.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, literature becomes either plot-summary or taste; the learner cannot reverse-engineer expressive possibility from masterworks.
modules.gate: Unseen close reading + competing interpretation + historical boundary

modules.title: Imitation, Transformation & Register Translation
modules.exit_capability: Preserve a chosen semantic core while radically altering voice, form, length, audience, or genre; imitate mechanisms without copying wording.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, stylistic knowledge remains recognizable but not generative.
modules.gate: Five-way transformation + style-feature defense

modules.title: Oral English, Cadence, Speech & Performance
modules.exit_capability: Turn written English into intelligible, persuasive, memorable speech and compose with the ear as well as the eye.
modules.deletion_reason: If missing, expressive control is confined to silent prose and misses spoken timing, emphasis, and embodied rhetoric.
modules.gate: Read-aloud revision + extemporaneous speech + oral defense

modules.title: Integrated Expressive Command & Editorial Judgment
modules.exit_capability: Express the same difficult content as explanation, argument, narrative, dialogue, lyric, speech, and concise summary; edit each toward exact intended effect.
modules.deletion_reason: This is the target itself: integration proves the components are available on demand rather than stored as separate coursework.
modules.gate: Capstone portfolio + unseen transformation exam + final defense

modules.title: Social Evidence, Interpretation & Comparative Method
modules.exit_capability: Separate observation, inference, model, interpretation, and normative claim; build competing causal stories and identify discriminating evidence.
modules.deletion_reason: Without this, every later social claim can become anecdote, ideological assertion, or false precision.
modules.gate: Unseen mixed-source case + rival explanation + defense

modules.title: Interaction, Identity, Norms & Influence
modules.exit_capability: Diagnose interpersonal and small-group behavior without reducing it to personality, manipulation, or stated motives.
modules.deletion_reason: Social systems are enacted through interaction; deleting this removes norm, identity, framing, and micro-foundations.
modules.gate: Interaction diagnosis + influence boundary + observation design

modules.title: Strategic Interaction, Bargaining & Cooperation
modules.exit_capability: Formalize strategic situations, predict changed incentives/information, and state where the model fails.
modules.deletion_reason: Without it, preferences and outcomes are conflated and conflict/cooperation remain descriptive.
modules.gate: Formalization + perturbation + adversarial defense

modules.title: Networks, Diffusion, Brokerage & Segregation
modules.exit_capability: Map relational structure and explain how position changes information, opportunity, diffusion, and collective outcomes.
modules.deletion_reason: Without it, outcomes are over-attributed to individual traits or formal institutions.
modules.gate: Network map + diffusion prediction + causal critique

modules.title: Collective Action, Public Goods, Commons & Public Choice
modules.exit_capability: Diagnose coordination failures and compare governance arrangements with explicit assumptions and gaming risks.
modules.deletion_reason: Shared interest does not imply coordinated action; this mechanism recurs from teams to climate governance.
modules.gate: Commons/public-good design + failure mode + defense

modules.title: Organizations, Bureaucracy, Professions & Delegation
modules.exit_capability: Trace decision and information chains inside organizations and redesign oversight without destroying useful discretion.
modules.deletion_reason: Organizations are not unitary actors; deleting this hides agency loss, expertise, routines, and metric gaming.
modules.gate: Delegation map + metric audit + redesign

modules.title: Power, Authority, Legitimacy & Resistance
modules.exit_capability: Distinguish forms of power and explain why rules are obeyed, contested, evaded, or transformed.
modules.deletion_reason: Without this, analysis either calls everything power or misses power whenever no direct command is visible.
modules.gate: Competing power models + boundary case + defense

modules.title: Markets, Prices, Firms & Property
modules.exit_capability: Explain when decentralized exchange coordinates well, where it fails, and why firms/rules/property structures arise.
modules.deletion_reason: Economic coordination is a major civilization mechanism not reducible to generic game theory or politics.
modules.gate: Market diagnosis + incidence + institutional alternative

modules.title: Money, Credit, Finance & Macroeconomic Coordination
modules.exit_capability: Trace balance-sheet and incentive channels from households/firms to financial and macro outcomes; analyze crisis mechanisms.
modules.deletion_reason: Without it, modern institutions, investment, crises, and macro policy remain opaque despite market knowledge.
modules.gate: Balance-sheet trace + crisis mechanism + policy tradeoff

modules.title: States, Law, Constitutions & Public Administration
modules.exit_capability: Trace who may make, interpret, implement, challenge, and enforce rules across multiple institutional forms.
modules.deletion_reason: A U.S.-only constitutional map is not a theory of states or law; this node globalizes the institutional substrate.
modules.gate: Rule/authority trace across two political systems

modules.title: Regimes, Representation, Parties, Media & Political Competition
modules.exit_capability: Explain how preferences are organized and converted into power under different regime and electoral structures.
modules.deletion_reason: Politics cannot be inferred from constitutional text alone; intermediation and regime incentives are load-bearing.
modules.gate: Preference-to-power trace + cross-regime comparison

modules.title: Stratification, Inequality & Social Reproduction
modules.exit_capability: Separate distribution, causal mechanisms, and normative judgments; explain persistence and change in advantage.
modules.deletion_reason: Averages conceal incidence; durable hierarchy is a recurrent social mechanism with distinct pathways.
modules.gate: Distribution ledger + reproduction mechanism + counterexample

modules.title: Family, Kinship, Demography, Migration & Cities
modules.exit_capability: Reason from demographic and household structure to labor, welfare, politics, urban systems, and intergenerational change.
modules.deletion_reason: Population and family structures drive institutions over decades and are not derivable from politics or markets alone.
modules.gate: Demographic transition / migration / city case

modules.title: Culture, Religion, Ideology, Nationalism & Collective Meaning
modules.exit_capability: Explain how shared meanings organize identity, legitimacy, coordination, conflict, and institutional persistence.
modules.deletion_reason: Material incentives do not exhaust human action; deleting meaning systems creates systematic explanatory blind spots.
modules.gate: Meaning-system reconstruction + rival material account

modules.title: Development, Growth, Industrialization & State Capacity
modules.exit_capability: Compare mechanisms of long-run development and explain why similar policies diverge across institutional contexts.
modules.deletion_reason: Frontier technology lives inside development trajectories; growth and state capacity are not just firm-level economics.
modules.gate: Comparative development case + mechanism discrimination

modules.title: Trade, Global Production, International Institutions & World Economy
modules.exit_capability: Trace gains, losses, bargaining power, and institutional constraints across borders and production networks.
modules.deletion_reason: Modern civilization is transnational; national-only models fail on supply chains, trade, finance, and governance.
modules.gate: Supply-chain / trade shock + distribution + policy options

modules.title: Conflict, War, Empire, Diplomacy & International Order
modules.exit_capability: Model conflict and bargaining under coercion, uncertainty, identity, and institutional constraints.
modules.deletion_reason: Large-scale coercion and geopolitical order cannot be safely treated as a special case of domestic politics.
modules.gate: Crisis bargaining + escalation ladder + historical comparison

modules.title: Historical Change, Path Dependence, Social Movements & Institutional Evolution
modules.exit_capability: Explain persistence and change through temporally ordered mechanisms rather than static snapshots or inevitability stories.
modules.deletion_reason: Without time, causal sequences, lock-in, contingency, and institutional evolution disappear.
modules.gate: Process trace + counterfactual + rival periodization

modules.title: Integrated Human Worlds Diagnosis & Institutional Design
modules.exit_capability: Produce and defend a global, historically situated diagnosis of a real institution/problem and design a reversible intervention with explicit failure tests.
modules.deletion_reason: This is the target: integration proves the modules are deployable rather than stored as isolated social-science vocabulary.
modules.gate: Capstone dossier + unseen perturbation + oral defense

modules.title: Learning as a Measurable System
modules.exit_capability: Define a learnable capability, baseline it, choose evidence, and distinguish performance today from retained transferable learning.
modules.deletion_reason: Without measurement, 'I studied it' substitutes for learning.
modules.gate: Design + baseline + delayed retest

modules.title: Attention, Working Memory & Cognitive Load
modules.exit_capability: Design environments and representations that respect limited attention and working memory.
modules.deletion_reason: AI abundance increases interruption and passive consumption risk.
modules.gate: Attention audit + redesign + unseen task

modules.title: Long-Term Memory, Schemas & Retrieval
modules.exit_capability: Build durable, organized knowledge that can be retrieved without the original context or tool.
modules.deletion_reason: Independent judgment needs stored structure, not search alone.
modules.gate: Knowledge map + delayed closed-book reconstruction

modules.title: Practice: Retrieval, Spacing, Interleaving & Feedback
modules.exit_capability: Construct a practice schedule that produces durable performance and detects illusions of fluency.
modules.deletion_reason: This is one of the strongest evidence-backed learning levers and is easy to lose when AI supplies answers.
modules.gate: 4-week practice protocol + retention test

modules.title: Mental Models, Representation & Transfer
modules.exit_capability: Choose representations that reveal mechanism and transfer a model to an unfamiliar domain.
modules.deletion_reason: Memorized answers do not create adaptive expertise.
modules.gate: Three representations + cross-domain transfer

modules.title: Expertise, Deliberate Practice & Tacit Knowledge
modules.exit_capability: Decompose expert performance, practice bottlenecks, and know when rules must become fluid rather than rigid.
modules.deletion_reason: AI can hide the skill-development path by producing expert-looking outputs.
modules.gate: Expertise decomposition + targeted practice + performance gain

modules.title: Metacognition, Calibration & Error Monitoring
modules.exit_capability: Track what you know, do not know, and which strategy should change after evidence.
modules.deletion_reason: High confidence in AI can suppress critical thinking; calibration must be trained explicitly.
modules.gate: Confidence ledger + Brier/calibration review + oral defense

modules.title: Motivation, Goals, Habits & Self-Regulation
modules.exit_capability: Build routines that sustain difficult learning and revise goals without self-deception.
modules.deletion_reason: Agency requires more than knowing the optimal study strategy.
modules.gate: Behavior redesign + 3-week adherence evidence

modules.title: Emotion, Stress, Sleep & Performance
modules.exit_capability: Recognize how state changes cognition and design work/learning around physiological constraints.
modules.deletion_reason: A tool can optimize a schedule while the learner still cannot regulate the human system executing it.
modules.gate: State/performance diary + experiment + boundary statement

modules.title: Perception, Motor Learning & Embodied Skill
modules.exit_capability: Acquire and refine a physical skill through observation, practice, feedback, and adaptation.
modules.deletion_reason: Embodied competence is not learned from verbal explanation alone.
modules.gate: New physical skill + video/measurement evidence + transfer

modules.title: Creativity, Analogy, Exploration & Problem Finding
modules.exit_capability: Generate diverse possibilities, identify promising anomalies, and choose questions worth pursuing.
modules.deletion_reason: When generation becomes cheap, problem selection and discriminating novelty become more important.
modules.gate: 100→10→1 idea funnel + novelty/mechanism defense

modules.title: Social Learning, Teaching, Mentorship & Collective Cognition
modules.exit_capability: Learn by teaching, use others' expertise, give useful feedback, and build teams that think better than isolated members.
modules.deletion_reason: Human learning remains social even with excellent tutors.
modules.gate: Teach an unseen learner + peer calibration + revision

modules.title: Development, Identity & Lifespan Learning
modules.exit_capability: Adapt learning environments and expectations to developmental stage, identity, culture, and changing capacity.
modules.deletion_reason: A next-generation curriculum needs a theory of the learner across time.
modules.gate: Age/stage redesign + bias/assumption audit

modules.title: Judgment Under Bounded Cognition
modules.exit_capability: Predict recurring human judgment failures and design checks that outperform willpower alone.
modules.deletion_reason: Formal probability and philosophy do not automatically change human behavior.
modules.gate: Bias trap set + precommitment/checklist experiment

modules.title: Human–AI Cognition, Trust & Delegation
modules.exit_capability: Use AI to extend thought while preserving learning, ownership, and calibrated trust.
modules.deletion_reason: This is the central cognitive skill of an AGI-transition curriculum.
modules.gate: Same task A0/A2/A3 + error-seeded audit + unaided retest

modules.title: Integrated Self-Directed Mastery System
modules.exit_capability: Run a 12-week self-directed program that demonstrably changes retained capability and survives tool/model changes.
modules.deletion_reason: The branch matters only if the learner can govern their own future learning.
modules.gate: 12-week mastery dossier + delayed exam + public defense

modules.title: Perception, Attention & Affordance
modules.exit_capability: See what a representation or object makes easy, hard, noticeable, or invisible.
modules.deletion_reason: Design begins in perception, not decoration.
modules.gate: Affordance/error audit + redesign

modules.title: Form, Composition, Hierarchy & Constraint
modules.exit_capability: Organize elements so attention and structure support purpose.
modules.deletion_reason: Without formal control, visual output becomes accidental or template-driven.
modules.gate: Three compositions under different constraints

modules.title: Drawing, Diagramming & Visual Reasoning
modules.exit_capability: Externalize structure visually and use diagrams to discover errors in thought.
modules.deletion_reason: Language/equations do not cover all spatial or relational reasoning.
modules.gate: Blank-page diagram + transform + defense

modules.title: Data Visualization & Information Design
modules.exit_capability: Choose visual encodings that reveal rather than distort quantity, uncertainty, and comparison.
modules.deletion_reason: AI can make beautiful charts that are epistemically bad.
modules.gate: Misleading-vs-honest redesign + unseen dataset

modules.title: Typography, Layout & Document Systems
modules.exit_capability: Create readable documents whose structure survives length, device, and audience.
modules.deletion_reason: Presentation changes comprehension and trust.
modules.gate: Long-document redesign + accessibility check

modules.title: Space, Maps, Architecture & Wayfinding
modules.exit_capability: Reason about space and guide human movement through physical or geographic environments.
modules.deletion_reason: Spatial design cannot be reduced to prose.
modules.gate: Map/space diagnosis + route/wayfinding redesign

modules.title: Objects, Materials, Craft & Industrial Design
modules.exit_capability: Design an object that fits bodies, materials, manufacturing, maintenance, and use.
modules.deletion_reason: Taste without making becomes superficial; engineering without user/form judgment becomes brittle.
modules.gate: Prototype + user trial + teardown critique

modules.title: Interaction, Interface & Service Design
modules.exit_capability: Design interactions that preserve agency, visibility, control, and graceful recovery.
modules.deletion_reason: AGI interfaces may mediate consequential decisions; HCI becomes civic infrastructure.
modules.gate: Interactive prototype + usability/error test

modules.title: Time, Motion, Sound & Multimodal Composition
modules.exit_capability: Shape experience over time across visual, auditory, and interactive media.
modules.deletion_reason: Static visual literacy misses a large fraction of modern communication.
modules.gate: Same content in static vs temporal form

modules.title: Aesthetics, Style, History & Global Traditions
modules.exit_capability: Recognize formal lineages and evaluate work without treating one culture's conventions as universal.
modules.deletion_reason: Taste without historical/world exposure collapses into local fashion.
modules.gate: Comparative critique across three traditions

modules.title: Prototyping, User Research, Critique & Iteration
modules.exit_capability: Turn uncertain assumptions into prototypes and observations; revise without overfitting to one user.
modules.deletion_reason: Design claims need evidence, not designer confidence.
modules.gate: Prototype-test-revise loop + negative findings

modules.title: Curation, Taste & AI-Generated Abundance
modules.exit_capability: Select and improve from hundreds of plausible AI outputs while preserving purpose, originality, and human preference.
modules.deletion_reason: Generation abundance makes selection and specification load-bearing.
modules.gate: 100-output curation + blind ranking + revision spec

modules.title: Integrated Design & Representation
modules.exit_capability: Build and defend a coherent information/interface/physical representation system across media.
modules.deletion_reason: Integration proves this is a branch rather than isolated design trivia.
modules.gate: Capstone + user/critic/technical panel
